correctness.rationale: Reconstructed finite-state Bellman equation V(v)=1+d(v)^-2 sum_{u,w in N(v)} min(V(u),V(w)), with uniform finite expected hitting under forced same-neighbor shortest-path offers. Solved decorated C5+leaves linear Bellman system and checked all order comparisons; k>=2 gap is positive quadratic and k=2 is 4/415, while k=0,1 have distance-first solutions. Independently checked all connected unlabeled graphs n<=6 from the full graph atlas, all marked targets (809 rooted cases), with exact rational solutions satisfying Bellman equality and no distance inversion. Inspected separate submitted exact policy-iteration code which exhausts all 27475 rooted labeled cases, with no pruning of graph masks. Infinite pendant k family rests on algebra, not these finite checks.
